name: DetectOutliersNode
label: Detect Outliers
description: Adds a boolean column flagging numeric outliers in a value column using the IQR or Z-score method. Computed per optional group columns.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the numeric column to analyze.

fields.name: ValueColumn
fields.label: Value Column
fields.description: The numeric column to detect outliers in.

fields.name: Method
fields.label: Method
fields.description: The detection method: 'IQR' or 'ZScore'. Defaults to 'IQR'.

fields.name: Threshold
fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: The IQR multiplier (e.g. 1.5) or Z-score cutoff (e.g. 3) depending on method. Defaults to 1.5.

fields.name: GroupByColumns
fields.label: Group By Columns
fields.description: Optional comma-separated columns to compute outlier statistics within. Leave empty to use the whole table.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the outlier flag column. Defaults to '<ValueColumn>_IsOutlier'.

fields.name: ResultDataTable
fields.label: Result Data Table
fields.description: The resulting data table with the outlier flag column.
